failure_handling: acquisition failure / rate-limit / missing history -> symbols marked FAILED/INCOMPLETE; never fabricates bars; never blocks protection (runs in worker thread, detached).

env_fix: Fixed a .env key-name typo: `aALPACA_API_KEY` -> `ALPACA_API_KEY` (stray leading 'a'). The codebase reads ALPACA_API_KEY, so the mistyped line was dead; earlier runs authenticated only via a shell-exported var. A fresh `python3 trade.py` relying on .env now authenticates correctly. .env is gitignored; the secret value was never read or modified, only the key name.
